title: Search results page
description: A results page with the query echoed in an editable search field, a result count, sort control, faceted filters, and results that show why they matched (highlighted terms, matched field). Covers zero results with suggestions, spelling hints, and a path to broaden filters.
intent: Help users judge relevance at a glance, narrow results, and recover from an empty result set.
characteristics: editable query field at the top with result count
result items with title, snippet with highlighted matches, and metadata
facets in a side column with counts
zero-results state with concrete recovery actions
pagination or load-more with stable URLs
interaction: Query, filters, sort, and page live in the URL; changing a filter updates results without losing scroll position of the filter panel; result count updates are announced.
responsive: Facets move into a filter sheet opened by a button that shows the active filter count; sort stays visible above results.
accessibility: Results are a list with headings or links as item titles; highlight uses mark, not color alone; result count change announced via a polite live region; filter sheet is a modal dialog with focus management.
limitations: Relevance depends on the backend; the page cannot fix poor ranking.
Snippet highlighting requires match offsets from the search service.
